note: round 3, the east-shore boat yards, 浪板 (c8, x 1050..1106, z -48..35) and 大浦 (c12, x 1135..1166, z 455..465). Moored boats, floats and the two slipway ships are not lots, roads or props, so the override schema has nothing to patch: the fix is in code (src/anime/world/harbor/yards.js, an explicit placement list called from harbor/world.js; MOORING_ROWS is not used because planMooringRows has no per-row type and would fill the yards with 50 m longliners moored stern-to). This file records the Earth 2026-03-11 readings it was made from and carries no operation. Method: the two top captures (raw/ref/earth/meta8928r3/c8n and c12N, camera tilted 5 degrees, so the cyan grid of the _view JPEGs is not linear in z) were ortho-rectified onto the ENU ground plane with the capture cameras of their meta.json, and every hull traced on 10..30 px/m crops of that. 浪板: 3 finger floats (grey, 2 m wide, running ENE) with 13 small boats of 6.5..9 m lying along them, bows west to south-west (axis -22..-33 deg from east); the app shore is 5..8 m west of the 2026 one at the ramp, so two hulls there are slid onto the app's water; 6 hulls dry on the ramp and the hardstand (x 1091..1106, z -39..-30); 1 white hull at the quay face (1081, -3); 3 boats and a 20 m float at the 小鯖 pier (1072..1092, 25..35); two grey pontoons 21 x 5.6 m at (1050..1072, -3..9); two ships on the 丸竹 slipway, a white one 29 x 7 m on the rails (x 1110..1139, z 1.5..13, bow up the slip) and a grey-white one 22 x 4 m at the ramp foot (x 1089..1111, z 6.5..12). 大浦: three grey workboats (9.5..11 m, 4..4.4 m beam) rafted at the pier end (1133..1150, 451..467), bows north-west, and a white 8 m boat at its mooring (1166, 460). Not found on Earth: a hull on rails near x 1136..1155, z 490..505 (the rails carry empty dark cradles; the pile at x 1112..1126, z 489..500 is dry-stored hulls too tightly packed to trace).
